The Soviet Union's new leadership is in some danger of losing its revolutionary fervor, its ability to shock the world and its claim to be the master of the world stage, analysts here said this week.

There are ominous signs that the new government is moving away from its reformist agenda and is reverting to the old Soviet system.

The homeowner got out of the car and tried to get Zaragoza away, but he refused to leave and barricaded himself inside the home.
"It's a very volatile situation to get the officers to get into the residence," Gautreaux said. "The officers had to use the least amount of force possible to safely remove the suspect from the residence."
Police were called to the home after a woman reported hearing shots fired outside. When officers arrived, a man ran out of the residence and told police Zaragoza was inside.
Police tried to break into the home, but the suspect refused to come out.
"They were using the least amount of force possible to safely remove the suspect from the residence," Gautreaux said.
Police were able to get the suspect out of the home without any injuries. He was later arrested and charged with aggravated assault with a deadly weapon.
